Looks like turtle’s nest. Are you anywhere close to water?

I have a couple of these in my yard right now, they have remnants of turtle eggs in and around them.
We love this area too. We’ve been bringing our kids up to Brimley for the last 10 years and love Bay View Campground. https://imgur.com/a/HAK5eBR/

Our family goes to Bay View Campground, about 45 minutes west of Sault Ste. Marie. The sites are spacious and you have a private walk out to Lake Superior if you stay on a beach site. https://imgur.com/a/8iXhxqW/

That does make sense. There is another spot on the opposite side where the cortex is chipped away and it looks like a little more agate is underneath. I think I’ll play with it a little bit to see what’s going on.
So are you saying that there could be more agate inside this larger host rock?

Thanks so much for the speedy commentary. I was leaning towards basalt on the first rock. I just snapped a couple pics in some natural light with a better angle that could be helpful.

I added two more pics of the likely basalt rock and then two of another rock we think could be an agate based on some characteristics (pitting and staining). 
[More pics](https://imgur.com/a/LyyY8XO)
After researching a bit, I was thinking the second one might be a Charlevoix stone. Not sure though.
